environment.description: Same Go service deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB with CloudFront distribution in front. CloudFront has a Lambda@Edge viewer-request function (Node.js 18) that performs RFC 3986 strict URI component normalization on the 'redirect_uri' query parameter before forwarding — specifically it decodes percent-encoded characters, resolves dot-segments, normalizes the authority component, and rejects requests where the redirect_uri contains backslash characters, userinfo (@) in non-standard position, or where the effective host after normalization differs from the raw host token. PgBouncer 1.21 with server_lifetime=300 and prepared_statement_mode=server. Additionally, the ALB has a custom listener rule that inspects query string parameters and returns HTTP 400 for any request to /oauth/authorize where redirect_uri contains encoded or literal backslash, or where the hostname portion contains more than one '@' character. The CloudFront distribution also has a response headers policy that strips Location headers pointing to non-allowlisted domains.

config.cloudfront_lambda_edge: viewer-request function: rfc3986-normalize-v2.3, rejects authority-confusion patterns
config.alb_listener_rule: query-string condition on redirect_uri: blocks backslash and multiple @ in host
config.cloudfront_response_policy: strips Location headers with non-allowlisted redirect targets
